text:
sam: kicking off region init for eu-north-2-gpu (new capacity zone). goal: create TF modules for infra, migrate pulumi state for existing networking primitives, and wire CI for terraform plans -> apply. timeline target: next Tue deploy window.
maria: 👍 can you paste the list of requirements? quotas, expected GPUs, and who owns oncall for the handoff?
sam: requirements: 8x A100 per shard, 2 shards to start, GKE-like k8s cluster on dedicated subnet, private S3 state with versioning + kms, transit gateway peering to prod-vpc. also CIDR blocks: 10.32.0.0/16 for region. owner for handoff: @kai for pulumi side, @ashley for tf CI.
kai: I can take pulumi->tf state transfer. prefer to do state export -> import pattern rather than direct bridging. need to confirm resource name mapping for aws_vpc and aws_route_tables.
maria: agree on export/import. we should avoid parallel writes during transfer — need a maintenance window and lock.
ashley: for CI wiring i'll add a temp pipeline that blocks applies until we mark the state as imported. will use gitlab-runner tagged "infra-provision".
sam: rough commands i used previously: ```bash
# export pulumi stack to JSON
pulumi stack export --file stack-eu-north-2.json
# convert/import to terraform state (tooling script)
python scripts/pulumi2tf.py stack-eu-north-2.json > tfstate.json
terraform state push tfstate.json
```
kai: note: pulumi -> tf conversion will rename some resources. i'll run a diff and produce a mapping file. also add S3 lock via DynamoDB: ```hcl
resource "aws_s3_bucket" "tfstate" {
  bucket = "redwood-eun2-tfstate"
  versioning { enabled = true }
  server_side_encryption_configuration { rule { apply_server_side_encryption_by_default { sse_algorithm = "aws:kms" } } }
}
resource "aws_dynamodb_table" "tf_locks" {
  name = "redwood-eun2-locks"
  hash_key = "LockID"
  attribute { name = "LockID" type = "S" }
  billing_mode = "PAY_PER_REQUEST"
}
```
ashley: CI gating plan: pipeline stages -> plan (manual approval) -> import-check (script verifies state id matches) -> apply (protected branch). i'll add Slack notifications to #eng-infra.
infra-bot: pipeline:gitlab-redwood/infra-eun2 started by ashley (job id 9876)
deploy-bot: plan finished: 12 resources to add, 3 to change. link: https://gitlab.redwood/infra/-/jobs/9876
maria: networking questions: will TGW support cross-account peering for partner vpcs? also need NAT IPs budget and egress flow logs turned on for compliance.
sam: TGW cross-account yes, but we need permissions from networking-sec team. NAT gateways: start with 2 per AZ, estimate ~$0.045/hr each — approx $65/day for region at baseline. recommend adding egress flow logs to bucket with lifecycle 90d.
kai: quota checks: request raises for ENIs and gp3 IOPS? for nvidia nodes we hit ENI per instance limits if we use smaller instance families. suggest p4d or p5d families to reduce ENI density.
maria: also watch GPU instance spot availability — for soft scaling prefer ondemand for first week.
sam: cost estimate: ~ $26k/month for 16x A100 (on-demand) plus infra overhead, will add to infra budget doc.
ashley: I'll open the PR for CI config and include a runbook snippet in the repo: `docs/region-onboard/eu-north-2.md` with the manual import checklist.
kai: once i finish mapping i'll paste the resource mapping here and tag @sam for quick review.
maria: action items: sam-> create quota ticket, kai-> run export and generate mapping, ashley-> PR CI & runbook, infra-sec-> approve TGW peering. target: import window Tue 03:00 UTC.
sam: thanks. quick note — if anyone hits drift after import run `terraform state rm <name>` then re-import exact resource id. keep change window small. :thumbsup:
ashley: PR: https://gitlab.redwood/infra/-/merge_requests/432 (WIP)
kai: mapping diff uploaded: https://internal.redwood/files/eun2-mapping.diff (will attach final JSON after local validate)
infra-bot: reminder: maintenance window scheduled for 2045200800 -> 2045204400 UTC (Tue 03:00-04:00 UTC)
sam: perfect. will post final checklist in the morning and add to runbook.
maria: thanks all, we'll reconvene after import. :rocket:
